notes:
### Fixed
- **"Fetch remaining prices" prices a set again.** The canonical catalogue
  migration renamed card ids, so TCGdex lookups were 404ing for most SV/ME-era
  sets. A single card still worked because it fell back to PkmnPrices, but the
  bulk button only ever asked TCGdex (and only for ten promo sets), so it
  silently found nothing. TCGdex ids are now rebuilt from a set alias plus the
  printed number (`src/data/tcgdexSets.ts`), and a bulk run uses the same
  provider chain as a single card — TCGdex, then PkmnPrices for anything TCGdex
  cannot price. The run now reports what happened instead of looking like a tap
  that did nothing. No scan-index rebuild.
